req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of marking a task as complete via the PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage. The tests are crafted to catch common mutation operators by asserting exact values, testing both sides of comparisons, and covering boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_positive
preconditions: Task with id 4 exists and is not completed
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/4 with payload {'completed': true}
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put('/tasks/4', json={'completed': True})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_negative
preconditions: Task with id 999 does not exist
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/999 with payload {'completed': true}
expected: Error message indicating task not found
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put('/tasks/999', json={'completed': True})
assert response.status_code == 404
assert 'Task with id 999 not found' in response.json()['detail']

tests.name: test_mark_task_complete_boundary
preconditions: Task with id 5 exists and is not completed
actions: Send PUT request to /tasks/5 with payload {'completed': true}
